notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
DNSenum automates subdomain brute-forcing plus zone transfer attempts, NS discovery, MX enumeration, and reverse lookups in one run. --enum shortcut enables default enumeration options. -r enables recursive brute-forcing — discovered subdomains are themselves tested as new enumeration targets.

=== WORDLIST STRATEGY ===
SecLists subdomains-top1million-20000.txt: standard starting point, statistically most common names. Custom wordlists: more efficient when target's naming conventions are known from job postings, documentation, or prior passive recon.

=== DETECTION ===
High volume of DNS queries in short period — detectable by DNS logging or rate-limiting on target's nameservers. Active technique — requires authorization. Generates as many queries as wordlist entries × target domains.
